concepts.prompt: Create ONE polished new Scooby brand logo concept using the prior dog/S/star logo as visual inspiration, not tracing its awkward contours. Direction: minimal monoline mascot. A refined friendly left-facing Great Dane dog profile, pointed ears, understated smile and small diamond collar tag, with a small five-point star cleverly integrated into the back of the collar. Clean geometric curves, thin consistent strokes, balanced compact square composition, excellent legibility. Single flat solid ice-cyan color #35D9EC only. Absolutely NO gradient, no shading, no glow, no textures, no stray pixels, no 3D. Genuinely transparent alpha background. No text. One professional vector-like logo, ample margins. Distinct new design, retain dog and star identity.

Use case logo-brand. Design a completely new premium minimal logo for a gaming brand named Scooby. ONE standalone symbol, no wordmark or text. Direction: clever S-star monogram. A clearly readable custom capital S constructed from one elegant continuous medium-thin ribbon, whose lower terminal seamlessly transforms into a crisp symmetrical five-point star outline. Sophisticated clean geometry, deliberate negative space, balanced compact silhouette, no dog illustration in this concept. Flat solid pure white color ONLY, genuinely transparent alpha background. Absolutely no gradients, no shading, no glow, no bevel, no texture, no 3D. Smooth immaculate vector-like edges. Centered square composition with comfortable padding. Must be a distinctive polished usable logo rather than generic clip art.
